title: Touch: a swipe or a two-finger pan scrolls the list under the finger

steps.say: Drive the touch layer with synthetic fingers on a scratch gump at the login screen, without a shard.

do.text: A one-finger swipe scrolls a ScrollArea and a text with its own scroll bar without moving the gump, and a two-finger pan over a list scrolls it as the mouse wheel does. A long press on someone in the world opens their context menu; that needs a shard and is not driven here.
